title: comandra umbellata subsp. pallida
intro: Comandra umbellata subsp. pallida, commonly known as pale comandra, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Elaeocarpaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of pale comandra include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display potential anticancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for further research and development.
